findings.issue: Opening an old cache rebuilds its live tables before validating sources. Missing, corrupt or mismatched sources can erase a usable cache; an unrecognized custom database is also rebuilt automatically.
The schema guard checks option_images alone, accepting a cache that is missing source_locator and returning questions without the promised provenance.
generate_shared_js still counts clicks on the newly introduced image/source anchors as answers when generating a fresh site.
Mobile PDF output truncates the source locator to the generic basename 試題.pdf; native print never exposes the source path or hash stored in data attributes.

All four image-question records retain subject-shaped category values. Exact category filtering in search/quiz excludes them under their normal category names, preventing the requested image feature from satisfying issue #58.

summary: Fixed five findings: unsafe SQLite cache rebuilding, incomplete schema detection, generated-site source clicks submitting answers, lost PDF provenance, and four image questions excluded by category filters. Regressions failed before the fixes; all 166 tests and two native-print PDF cases now pass. Changes are committed locally only; remote CI, deployment, and full assistive-technology/mobile-device acceptance remain unverified.
